$description: Third-party packages shipped with an SDK package under a licence outside the allow-list (ADR-023 rule 7), read by tools/check-licences.mjs. An entry passes when approvedBy and approved are set by counsel; one awaiting counsel warns until reviewBy and fails after it. installScript: true allows a package's install script, with the reason.

exceptions.name: axe-core
exceptions.reason: The accessibility engine of @ux-builder/audit, used unmodified as a dependency. MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft: modified axe-core files would have to be published; using it unmodified does not extend MPL to our code.

exceptions.name: @csstools/css-syntax-patches-for-csstree
exceptions.reason: Reached through stylelint, a peer dependency of @ux-builder/ui's lint rules. MIT-0 is MIT without the notice condition.

exceptions.name: @csstools/selector-resolve-nested
exceptions.reason: Reached through stylelint (peer dependency). MIT-0 is MIT without the notice condition.

exceptions.name: @csstools/selector-specificity
exceptions.reason: Reached through stylelint (peer dependency). MIT-0 is MIT without the notice condition.

exceptions.name: argparse
exceptions.reason: Reached through eslint (peer dependency, via js-yaml). The Python Software Foundation licence is permissive.

exceptions.name: minimatch
exceptions.reason: Reached through eslint and stylelint (peer dependencies). Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0 is permissive, with a patent grant.

exceptions.name: elkjs
exceptions.reason: The graph layout engine of @ux-builder/visuals (ADR-042), used unmodified as a dependency, never bundled or changed. EPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft: modified elkjs files would have to be published under it; using it unmodified does not extend EPL to our code, the same reasoning as axe-core's MPL-2.0. It lays out network, pipeline, state machine, entities and tree; zoned, lanes, sequence and lifecycle are our own placement and do not use it. If counsel refuses, the fallback is @dagrejs/dagre (MIT) for network and pipeline, with more of our own placement for compound states and field-level entity references, where dagre is weaker.
